propositions: 23 sites in test_concurrency_regression.py use _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run(repo, 'list') pattern to establish fixture preconditions via unasserted side effect, causing silent setup failures under CI load when ensure_fresh swallows errors

8 of the 23 sites are load-bearing fixture preconditions (Kind-P) where sync must land deterministically or the test precondition fails silently; these should use checked git fetch + ff-only merge via _sync_from_origin

15 of the 23 sites are read-side reconvergence tests (Kind-R) where the production read path sync IS the behavior under test; converting them to deterministic git would delete the invariant they exist to prove

After conversion, all 8 Kind-P sites pass under REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off with their downstream asserts labeled SETUP, and all 15 Kind-R sites route through _reconverge_by_read_sync to document why best-effort semantics are deliberate
Raw _git push legs (18 sites, separate category) are fail-fast check=True and not sync-by-side-effect, so outside this ticket's scope
